steps.speaker: Young Serpent
steps.content: I was speaking serpent tongue just now. I used to have a little snake about this long. It was my good friend.

steps.speaker: Young Serpent
steps.content: Well, language doesn't really matter. It's just a little beast-taming trick from a circus performer.

steps.speaker: Young Serpent
steps.content: Marv doesn't understand human language. You can't reason with it, either. I can only use serpent tongue to awaken its instinctive fear.

steps.speaker: Young Serpent
steps.content: Don't try to go close to it when I'm not paying attention. You can't handle it. Marv is not like me. It'll really eat you up.
She says this with a casual wave of her hand, as if your struggle with the monster was just an illusory dream.

But your breathing has not returned to normal. Your body is cold, your vision is blurred, and your mind is a jumble. You still haven't shaken off the horrible feeling of being haunted by that "thing."
That was "Marv," the powerful Mania mutant who possesses the same mind control power as Catalyst Sinners. Under the FAC rating system, its threat level is at least A+ or above.

Now it's trapped in this confined space, tamed by a Sinner. Why did Serpent stop Marv from killing you? Was it out of the kindness of her heart? Or for deterrence? Or did she just want to toy with you, her prey?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Is Marv a monster you're raising?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It filtered people's consciousness, devouring only happiness, while the negative feelings left behind turned into spiritual contamination. After the victims were drained of happiness, they became Corruptors... That's the truth of the cases back then.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Did you make it do this? Are you behind the Marv case, as well as the Sleepwalkers' case now?

steps.speaker: Young Serpent
steps.content: What are you talking about? Why would I let it devour others' happiness? I want to give everyone happiness!

steps.speaker: Young Serpent
steps.content: I've trained Marv well.
As if to reassure you, Serpent reaches out to pat your head, but you dodge her touch. This girl is powerful enough to crush you like an ant.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It devours others' happiness, yet you keep it in your Realm of Dreams. Don't you find that contradictory?
Serpent chuckles and pulls back her hand. With a flick of her wrist, a crystal bottle appears in her hand. It's the same one you saw in Mess's dream. She squeezes it with a bit of force...
The monster in the shadows wails, while radiant liquid fills up the empty bottle.

steps.speaker: Young Serpent
steps.content: This is the <color=#fb9259>Bottle of Dreams</color>, which is also Marv's heart. Marv loves to devour the joy in people's hearts, so its own heart can make Ambrosia and induce others' happiness...

steps.speaker: Young Serpent
steps.content: Marv keeps eating and eating non-stop. It also wants to find some "Corpus" to make a Black Ring appear. And it wants me. To trap me in a dream and drain my joy, to turn me into a walking dead.

steps.speaker: Young Serpent
steps.content: Ha, but too bad it's so weak... Not only did it fail to eat me, but also got a good whipping from me. It never dared to challenge me again. Now, it's an obedient little servant of mine.
Serpent chuckles and casts a contemptuous look at the shadowy monster.

steps.speaker: Young Serpent
steps.content: Don't worry. I won't let it hurt anyone. Marv is bad, but Ambrosia is good. It can peer into your heart and bring you true happiness.

steps.speaker: Young Serpent
steps.content: I use it to bring happiness to everyone...

options: So you captured Marv for the Ambrosia?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is a monster created for the "Black Ring." The Ambrosia it creates is dangerous spiritual contamination, and its so-called happiness is only a distortion of human consciousness.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've seen similar monsters before. It will only conjure up happiness to deceive and lure you into addiction. The human heart is just its nourishment. It can't give you true happiness.

steps.speaker: Young Serpent
steps.content: Ha, no. It didn't deceive me.

steps.speaker: Young Serpent
steps.content: I knew from the first time I used it that it won't use happiness to trick me for its own purposes.

steps.speaker: Young Serpent
steps.content: Ambrosia is the most honest. It knows the human heart. See? It's the only thing that dares to tell me that I'm joyless, and that I've lost all happiness long ago.
The curtain falls with a raucous swoosh, revealing an empty stage devoid of laughter, sunshine, and warmth.
The girl opens up her arms gleefully and twirls around. Her laughter echoes across this empty "dreamscape."

steps.speaker: Young Serpent
steps.content: Even though I don't have my own happiness, everyone else does! I want to see everyone be happy on my behalf!
Just as you're pondering about how to respond with a lump in your throat, something grabs your ankle.
As if aware of your intentions, black goo has oozed out from the ground and begins to talk.

steps.speaker: Hoarse Pleading
steps.content: No... Don't take it away, don't destroy it...

steps.speaker: Hoarse Pleading
steps.content: Don't awaken me, don't leave me...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: See, everyone needs sweet dreams. Everyone needs happiness.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I want to make everyone happy.
The wooden frames around you suddenly vibrate, and more black goo pours out of them. You get entangled and pulled into the chaotic mental vortex.
